summary:

• 6 upside misses — AC.PA +4%, RNO.PA +3%, EOAN.DE +3%, SAN.PA +3%, BMW.DE +3%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (IGG.L -3%, SU.PA -3%, BNZL.L -3%, DPLM.L -3%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: AC.PA (+3.56%) — No obvious news catalyst found for Accor (AC.PA) on 2026-10-21; likely a rebound or sector move in European travel and hotel stocks. Q3 2026 revenue is probably not out yet. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: AC.PA is a mid/large-cap French hotel operator on Euronext Paris, and no strategy covers it. A +3.56% move with no news also wouldn't trigger a news-reactive signal.
